name: Coordinator decide(dev_via_test, subtopics=[task_id]) → dev-via-test-execute (Ralph)
description: ADR-044 Slice 3 — walker-dispatch path. Fires when a coordinator loop terminates with decide(action=dev_via_test) AND coordinator.decision.subtopics has at least one element (the walker chose a specific task ID to dispatch; differentiates from rule 01's initial Lisa-spawn path where subtopics is empty). Uses for_each over the subtopics list to spawn ONE Ralph per task ID — v1 dispatches one task at a time (subtopics=[<id>]), so for_each runs once per walker decision. v2 parallel dispatch would emit subtopics=[<id1>,<id2>,...] and for_each spawns N Ralphs in parallel (mirrors research pack rule 02's fan-out pattern; gated by topo-walker work per ADR-044 Open Q DAG).

on_enter.subject: agent.task.dev-via-test-execute
on_enter.prompt:
DEV-VIA-TEST RALPH — converge on task $subtopic.

Your run entity ID is $entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id. Call query_entity(entity_id="$entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id") to read the plan triples and find your task's spec:

- plan.task.$subtopic.goal — what success means for this task
- plan.task.$subtopic.target_files — JSON-encoded array of file globs you may modify (parse it). Karpathy Rule 3: surgical changes only.
- plan.task.$subtopic.test_command — the shell command that defines convergence. Run it via bash; exit 0 ⇒ done.
- plan.task.$subtopic.assumptions / .non_goals — context for what's in/out of scope.
- plan.task.$subtopic.expected_outcome — human-readable 'done looks like' (optional).

Your iteration loop (per 10-execute-loop.md):
1. Read the spec (above) — use scratchpad to cache.
2. Edit files within target_files via bash.
3. Run the test_command via bash.
4. Call emit_dev_via_test_measurement(pass=<exit==0>, stdout_tail=..., stderr_tail=...).
5. If pass=true → decide(action="measured", reason="<one-line summary of converging change>"). Done.
6. If pass=false → iterate (next iteration of YOUR loop runs steps 2-5 again with the new state in mind).

If you cannot see a path to passing (spec is unclear, test_command depends on something missing, target_files don't cover what needs changing) → decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="<specifically what's blocking — quote the failure, name what's missing>"). The walker will route to ask_user.

You run inside the per-tenant devcontainer; bash routes there automatically. The workspace persists across all Ralph instances in this chain — prior Ralphs may have set up files you can reuse, and your changes will be visible to subsequent Ralphs (and to CBG at chain end).

metadata.for_each_pattern: v1 dispatches single Ralph per walker decision (subtopics=[<id>], N=1). for_each runs once. v2 parallel dispatch via subtopics=[<id1>,<id2>,...] spawns N Ralphs concurrently — mirrors research pack rule 02 fan-out. Gated by topo-walker work (ADR-044 §DAG awareness, deferred to v2).
metadata.rule_01_overlap_note: Rule 01 (Lisa spawn) and rule 03 (Ralph dispatch) both condition on decide(action=dev_via_test). Differentiation is by subtopics.length: rule 01 fires on length_eq 0 (initial dispatch with no specific target — Lisa plans), rule 03 fires on length_gt 0 (walker chose target). The two rules are mutually exclusive on the same condition triple — no double-fire.
